spellbook.finance/limitations: An empty page can have a nextCursor when a filter needs more bounded scans. Continue while nextCursor is non-null before concluding the filter has no matches.
Each response has at most 100 alerts. Keep workspaceId, status, alertType and limit unchanged when following nextCursor.
A refreshed first page includes new alerts. Status changes use live filter membership during cursor traversal, not a fixed snapshot.
It never means an asset is unwatched by another workspace.
status is the last state SpellBook stored. A triggered alert is not evaluated again by this read.
Delegated reads require workspace membership, and membership remains backend-enforced.

description: Read one bounded page of price alerts and buylist watches saved in a workspace, with each row's type, asset, direction and threshold when present, status, and trigger fields. Filter by status or alertType. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters to continue. It reports saved alerts and does not evaluate them or say whether a price would trigger one today.

alertType.description: Return only alerts of this type, such as buylist_watch. Omit to include every type.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Keep workspaceId, status, alertType and limit unchanged.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this page. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

status.description: Return only alerts in this status. Omit to include every status.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose alerts to read, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_alerts_list
